How It Works

Your Move in 4 Simple Steps

From first message to final setup — most local moves are booked within one WhatsApp conversation.

1

Send Your Details

Message us on WhatsApp or use the quote form — tell us where you're moving from, to, and what you're moving.

2

Get a Clear Quote

We confirm the truck size, crew and price upfront — low-cost rates with insurance options explained clearly.

3

We Pack & Move

On moving day the crew packs, wraps, dismantles and loads everything into a covered truck with care.

4

Setup & Settle In

At your new home we unload, unpack and re-fix your furniture — beds, wardrobes, TV and curtains included.

Good to Know

Questions, Answered

A full move includes packing with supplied materials (boxes, tape, bubble wrap), furniture dismantling, loading, transport in a covered truck, unloading, unpacking and furniture re-fixing at your new home. Handyman extras like TV mounting, curtains and fridge / washer connection can be added.

Two sizes: a 1-ton pickup for single items, rooms and small studios, and a 3-ton covered truck for apartments, villas and offices. The covered body keeps your furniture protected from heat and dust on the road.

Insurance options are available — basic transit insurance, or full value protection for complete peace of mind on valuable items. Tell the team what matters most and they'll confirm the right cover in your quote.

The team is based in Al Reeman 1, Al Shamkha, Abu Dhabi and covers the whole capital — Al Reem Island, Khalifa City, Mussafah, Al Raha and beyond — plus inter-city moves across all emirates including Dubai, Sharjah, Al Ain, Umm Al Quwain and Fujairah, and international relocation.

Send the quote form above or message +971 58 156 7732 on WhatsApp with your locations, property size and moving date. You'll get a clear, low-cost quote with everything itemised — no hidden charges added later.

Yes — single-item and room shifting is a regular Rajaani service, from a sofa or wardrobe to a full bedroom set. The 1-ton pickup keeps small moves quick and affordable.
